name: Andrew "Helicopters of DC" Logan
biography: Andrew Logan is an audio engineer, independent aviation journalist and developer @HelicoptersofDC who presented Tracking Military Ghost Helicopters over Washington DC at Def Con 30. Since then his advocacy urging lawmakers to review ADS-B exemptions for government aircraft has been cited by the Senate in the wake of the Flight 5342 crash.
